mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedback (org_id, activity_id, account_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{activityId}, #{accountId}, #{rating}, #{comment})

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO feedback_eligibility (activity_id, account_id, source) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{accountId}, #{source})
